plan.notes: Official Fullerton College Program Pathways Mapper (fullcoll.programmapper.com), site-content year 2025-2026; pathway “to Certificate”. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total credits (12) = sum of published pathway slots. Per-course prerequisites are not published in structured form on the mapper, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty; see the official catalog's course descriptions for official prerequisites. A prerequisite naming a course outside the published pathway would be listed in external_prereqs, never invented into a term. The official map also shows 1 advising milestone(s) (e.g. graduation-application reminders); these are not credit-bearing requirements and are not modeled as courses.

courses.title: Choose a course
courses.choice_note: Choose one course from the official map's “Choose a course” list (11 options). Recommended/first option: BUS 162 F. Map description: Choose a course NOT previously taken. Students need to complete a minimum of 6 units from this list to fulfill this requirement. NOTE:  BUS 240F or BUS 240HF or BUS 245F are "OR" courses and will only count for ONE course on this list. If you decide to take one of these 3 courses (BUS 240F or BUS 240HF or BUS 245F), you will take another course from this list NOT in parentheses (BUS 240F or BUS 240HF or BUS 245F). Refer to the catalog to view the list of courses.  https://catalog.nocccd.edu/fullerton-college/degrees-certificates/business/finance-skills-certificate/
